def: indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty

occurrences.text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
